resumen: in / on / at (tiempo): in con meses, años y partes del día (in the morning); on con días y fechas (on Monday); at con horas y en at night.
since / for / during: since + punto de partida (since I was twelve), for + duración (for three years) y during + un periodo o evento concreto (during the film), nunca + número de años.
by / until: by fija un plazo para una acción puntual (Send it by Friday.); until indica que algo dura hasta ese momento (The shop is open until six.).
Adjetivo + preposición: good at, interested in, afraid of, responsible for, keen on, similar to: She's keen on photography.
Verbo + preposición: depend on, consist of, apply for, insist on, succeed in, congratulate on, prevent from; detrás de la preposición va -ing: She insisted on paying.
Sustantivo + preposición: the reason for, a solution to, an increase in prices (pero an increase of 15% cuando se da la cantidad).
Expresiones fijas: on purpose (adrede), by mistake (por error), in charge of, on behalf of, in spite of (o despite, sin of): I deleted it by mistake.

preguntas.q: Our flight leaves ___ night, so we'll land in Madrid early ___ the morning.
preguntas.x: Se dice at night (sin artículo) e in the morning para las partes del día. On solo va con días y fechas (on Monday, on the morning of 5 May), así que on the morning sin fecha no sirve.

preguntas.q: I've been learning English ___ I was twelve years old.
preguntas.x: Con el present perfect, since marca el punto de partida, que puede ser una fecha o una cláusula (since I was twelve). From también se traduce «desde», pero no introduce una cláusula así, y for va con duraciones (for ten years).

preguntas.q: We might go to Antigua on Saturday, but it depends ___ the weather.
preguntas.x: El verbo es depend on: it depends on the weather. Depend of es un calco de «depender de» y uno de los errores más típicos del hispanohablante.

preguntas.q: My brother is really good ___ fixing laptops: he repaired mine in ten minutes.
preguntas.x: Para hablar de habilidades se usa good at + sustantivo o -ing: good at fixing laptops. Good in es un calco de «bueno en» y no se usa con -ing.

preguntas.q: Before moving to London, Lucía lived in Edinburgh ___ three years.
preguntas.x: For + duración responde a «¿cuánto tiempo?»: for three years. During no va con una cantidad de tiempo sino con un periodo o evento concreto (during the summer), así que during three years es un calco de «durante tres años».

preguntas.q: The library stays open ___ 8 p.m., so I have to return these books ___ then.
preguntas.x: Until indica que una situación continúa hasta ese momento (stays open until 8 p.m.); by fija un plazo para una acción puntual (return them by then = «a más tardar entonces»). Return … until then calca «devolver hasta entonces».

preguntas.q: ___ the heavy traffic, we got to the airport in time for our flight.
preguntas.x: In spite of (o despite, sin of) va seguido de un sustantivo: in spite of the heavy traffic. Despite of e in spite sin of son errores, y even though necesita una cláusula (even though the traffic was heavy).

preguntas.a: Lots of people are afraid of speaking in public.
d: Who is responsible of the new website?
My sister is very keen in photography.
This phone is very similar than mine.
preguntas.x: Las combinaciones fijas son afraid of, responsible for, keen on y similar to. Responsible of calca «responsable de» y es el error más frecuente; similar than mezcla la estructura de los comparativos.

preguntas.q: Carla applied ___ a student visa as soon as she got the offer from the University of Leeds.
preguntas.x: Apply for + lo que quieres conseguir (a visa, a job, a grant); apply to + la institución a la que te diriges (apply to a university). Por eso apply to a visa no funciona.

preguntas.a: We congratulated Ana on winning the hackathon.
d: Our manager insisted in paying for lunch.
The course consists on six modules.
It depends of how much time we have.
preguntas.x: Cada verbo lleva su preposición fija: congratulate someone on, insist on, consist of y depend on. Las otras tres opciones calcan «insistir en», «consistir en» y «depender de».

preguntas.q: Don't blame Tom. He didn't delete the file ___ purpose; he did it ___ mistake.
preguntas.x: Son expresiones fijas: on purpose = «a propósito, adrede» y by mistake = «por error». No se intercambian: by purpose y on mistake no existen.

preguntas.q: The heavy rain prevented the players ___ the match.
preguntas.x: Prevent + persona + from + -ing = «impedir que alguien haga algo»: prevented the players from finishing. Prevent someone to do es un calco de «impedirle a alguien hacer algo».

preguntas.q: I'm writing ___ the whole team to thank you for organising the conference.
preguntas.x: On behalf of = «en nombre de, en representación de»: I'm writing on behalf of the team. La expresión es fija (on … of), así que on behalf for o by behalf of son errores.

preguntas.q: Choose the sentence that means the same as: “Mr Ruiz manages the IT department.”
preguntas.a: Mr Ruiz is in charge of the IT department.
d: Mr Ruiz is in the charge of the IT department.
Mr Ruiz is in charge for the IT department.
Mr Ruiz is on charge of the IT department.
preguntas.x: Be in charge of = «estar a cargo de, dirigir». Con artículo, be in the charge of someone significa lo contrario (estar bajo el cuidado de alguien), y in charge for y on charge of no existen.

preguntas.q: Choose the sentence that means the same as: “The course is made up of six modules.”
preguntas.a: The course consists of six modules.
d: The course is consisted of six modules.
The course consists in six modules.
The course composes of six modules.
preguntas.x: Consist of = «estar formado por» y nunca va en pasiva (is consisted of es incorrecto). Consist in existe, pero significa «radicar en» (Success consists in hard work); con compose se usa la pasiva: is composed of.

preguntas.q: After months of trying, she finally succeeded ___ a job at a tech start-up in Toronto.
preguntas.x: Succeed in + -ing = «lograr hacer algo»: succeeded in finding. Si quieres un infinitivo, el verbo es manage (managed to find); succeed to solo significa «suceder en un cargo» (succeed to the throne).

preguntas.a: Nobody has found a solution to the overheating problem yet.
d: What was the reason of the delay at the airport?
Regular practice is the key of success.
The storm caused serious damage of the roof.
preguntas.x: Muchos sustantivos tienen preposición fija: a solution to, the reason for, the key to y damage to. The reason of y the key of calcan «la razón de» y «la clave de».

preguntas.q: Last year there was an increase ___ 15% ___ the number of international students.
preguntas.x: An increase of + la cantidad (of 15%) y an increase in + lo que aumenta (in the number of students). Lo mismo vale para rise, fall y decrease.
